description: No2SQL MCP server for inferring SQL schema and ER diagrams from MongoDB databases.
name: io.github.Ptalati015/no2sql

environmentVariables.name: NO2SQL_MONGO
environmentVariables.description: MongoDB connection string, including any credentials. Treat it as a secret and set it only in your MCP client's env config.

environmentVariables.name: NO2SQL_ALLOWED_DATABASES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of database names the server may read. Recommended: list only the databases you want analysed. Default (empty): every database not blocked by NO2SQL_BLOCK_SYSTEM_DATABASES.

environmentVariables.name: NO2SQL_BLOCK_SYSTEM_DATABASES
environmentVariables.description: When true (default), the MongoDB system databases admin, config and local are blocked. Keep it true unless you have a specific need.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open: the MCP client talks to the server over stdin and stdout.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the client disconnects.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: The image defaults to HTTP mode; this runs it as a stdio server.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Passes NO2SQL_MONGO from the client's environment into the container without putting it on the command line.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Passes NO2SQL_ALLOWED_DATABASES into the container when it is set.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Passes NO2SQL_BLOCK_SYSTEM_DATABASES into the container when it is set.
